holdoutPeople: (n+2)//5 of all original participants before sample eligibility; no reseeding
participantUniverse: CGMacros: 45 sensor-file participants, not gut-only 24/25; LifeSnaps: all 71 daily-table IDs
exclusionOrder: source quality -> amount column absent -> amount missing/invalid -> nonpositive amount -> other food within +/-120min -> device-window diagnostics; excluded food records still block nearby meals
budgetTiers: per source: smoke 2 learning cases per site and 6 evaluation cases total; first 10 per site and 24 evaluation total; all; optional nonoverlap view; choose evaluation round-robin across people independent of outcome
fileOrder: evaluation inputs sorted by opaque case ID, not participant or chronology

cgmacros.amount: finite positive raw value required; no units inferred; raw/status only in provenance, not model input
cgmacros.quality: nutrition_candidate true and no existing quality_flags
cgmacros.reference: released interpolated grid, not raw independent measurements or causal recommendation benefit; own baseline protocol, not an exact author-notebook reproduction

lifesnaps.profileConsensus: only the three historical rows of this person; any missing/conflict -> null with flag; never target/future rows
lifesnaps.reference: released mainSleep/dateOfSleep aggregates; no exact sleep start/end available; one-day embargo reduces overnight overlap, not a validated prospective or intervention task

evaluation.metric: absolute error, mean within each participant then equal mean across participants
evaluation.invalidPrediction: unscored plus coverage; never replace with zero or silently claim benefit; require both arms 100% parse coverage for a complete benefit conclusion
evaluation.execution: one independent stateless conversation per case; only input is model payload, opaque id is metadata; runner not implemented here

budget.meaning: template observation records cost zero initial generation calls; N extra calls for optional synthetic explanations; reflect/extract 2N, profile/library 2B, proposed probe B, two-arm numeric answers 2M; conditional on future validated adapter and bounded retrieval, not all per-batch libraries pasted into prompt
budget.reserveMeaning: planning reserve only, not worst-case retries or an approved cap; no verified current price, no currency estimate
